name: Telekinetic Slam, Mass
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 4, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

Targets one creature/2 levels, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as telekinetic slam except it affects multiple creatures and the maximum is 15d6.
